page.overview:
Who is Sunny Rays?

Sunny Rays is a background female Pegasus pony with a bright yellow coat, pink mane and tail with a lavender pink streak, pink eyes, and a cutie mark of three suns. She is unnamed in the show, but she is named in merchandise.__TOC__

Sunny Rays is identical to Merry May apart from her coat colors, shares her design and mane and tail colors with S04E10 Unnamed Pegasus Mare #3, shares her design and cutie mark with "Velvet Light" and "Skyra", shares her design with Cloud Kicker, "Spring Skies", "Sky Sweeper", and "Sugar Apple", shares her mane and tail style with Lily Valley, shares her mane style with "Bon Voyage" and "Lavender Skies", shares her tail style with [https://apps.facebook.com/ponyscopes/ Pisces], and shares her cutie mark with S06E04 Unnamed Earth Mare #2 and bespectacled Apple Cobbler.

She doesn't appear again until the season four episode For Whom the Sweetie Belle Toils. She—with a darker color scheme—is among the ponies at the award ceremony in Sweetie Belle's dream. In Equestria Games, Sunny Rays briefly appears—with a darker coat color—as a spectator of the titular event at the Crystal Empire.

In Twilight's Kingdom - Part 1, Sunny Rays—once again with a darker color scheme—appears very briefly in the auditorium when Discord and Lord Tirek appear.
